# matchedfilter COST table -- RELATIVE cost per configuration, measured
#
# cpu     AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S
# commit  398fa6f
#
# Cost RELATIVE to a pivot configuration at the same transform length, not
# microseconds. Absolute time is a property of machine, load and reference
# together; the ratio is a property of the configuration, which is the only
# thing selection needs.
#
# Measured by holding ONE reference fixed and timing every configuration on
# it, cycling rather than running each to completion, and dividing by a pivot
# measured in the same loop. Clock and turbo state, contention, cache
# temperature and the machine cancel in the ratio -- which is also what makes
# it safe to measure these in parallel on every core.
#
# Ranks configurations; do not read them as predictions of runtime.
#
# Regenerate for your own CPU:
#   python tools/hmf_tune.py --retune-cost --out mycost.txt
#   export MF_COST=$PWD/mycost.txt
#
# Baseline measurements retained during gate-model migration; see docs/gate-model.md.
# COST n band U K snr f beff relative_cost
